status: Derived from public WebAssembly module and old public scripts; independent local implementation, no original-runtime equality claim

pair_response.cadence: Original runs on even physics frames with2*delta; local uses accumulated1/30s simulation time

shield_front.condition: opposing teams and enemy on forward half-plane of either shield normal

pair_response.equation: delta * dt * strength / combined_scaled_radius * (1 - distance_squared / radius_squared)
pair_response.same_team_formations: skip pair if each has shield-wall or formation-moving flag, irrespective of wall identity
pair_response.shield_anchor: do not write pair displacement to the shield-bearing person; this does not cancel separate knockback
pair_response.coincident_points: At distance_squared<=0.01 use two sequential32-bit LCG samples with multiplier1103515245 increment12345, components in[-1,1], scale min(16,dt*strength*0.5)
pair_response.frozen_or_deploy: Pair excluded in native flags6; local excludes petrified/stunned and only runs during battle

velocity.knockback_decay: multiply each component by pow(0.85,delta*60); set component to0 when abs<0.5
velocity.bounds: original clamps to symmetric map bounds; local authored terrain uses existing bounds and footprint checks

implemented: Same-team/opponent/shield-front pair formulas, formation skip, shield anchoring, deep compression, per-pair caps and coincident-point RNG
Removed hard circle rejection and heuristic personal body-bypass steering; local visible-graph pathfinding remains
Ground physics reads actor.position rather than accumulating visible hit-shift into physical position
Replaced guessed knockback decay with native0.85-per60Hz and per-component cutoff
Repulsion cadence and RNG reset with new battle; stop-decision position recorded separately from subsequent passive displacement
remaining_differences: Pair traversal uses local deterministic row/cell order, not native hash iteration and pooled slot order
Pair grid built after local movement, whereas original grid is built before state/velocity updates
Original native terrain-grid and circular obstacle response not reproduced; local authored rock footprints and axis slide retained
Knockback integrates before local actor decisions rather than same native velocity pass after all decisions; charge control and hard rock stopping remain separate
Native idle/hold/attack deceleration and attack-animation state timing still incomplete
Native charge applies raw knockback even to shield-wall targets; previous hard-circle stopping is not an equivalence requirement
Latest Steam and original runtime three-scenario equality not verified
